_readme: Hand-written TOP DEALS for the homepage rail ('De beste deals van vandaag'). A top deal ALWAYS outranks the auto-generated kortingscode and sale cards and takes the first (left-most) slots. Fully manual: nothing is pulled from the live feeds. Each deal has: slug (a real brand-page slug, e.g. 'gymshark' or 'oduree.nl' — drives the logo, name and link; does NOT need a code or sale in the feeds), text (free text shown on the card, keep it short), date (YYYY-MM-DD, shown as 'Gespot op ...' and used to order multiple deals, newest first), OPTIONAL url (a specific landing page for this promotion — when set the card links there in a new tab; when omitted or empty the card links to the normal brand page for the slug), and OPTIONAL image (see _image_readme). Top deals do NOT auto-expire — remove the entry when it's no longer relevant. Empty 'deals' array = rail behaves as before (4 codes + 1 sale).
_image_readme: OPTIONAL 'image': artwork for the coloured strip at the top of the card. When set it replaces both the sky→butter gradient and the brand name printed on it (the logo still shows in the card below). Drop the file in public/deals/ and reference it from the site root, e.g. "image": "/deals/gymshark-zomersale.webp". Sizing: the strip is 340x104 CSS px, so export ~680x208 for retina; .webp preferred. IMPORTANT — the white card overlaps the bottom of this strip, leaving only the top ~32px (mobile) / ~56px (desktop) visible, so keep the important part of the artwork in the TOP HALF; the image is cropped with object-fit: cover, anchored to its top edge. Best results with a wide, low-detail banner (pattern, product close-up, brand colour) rather than something with text or a centred subject.
